QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Proving Your Worth
QuestInfo.0: After much cajoling from you and Butler, Gurnardson has agreed to let you into the city, but only if you can prove you can earn your keep there.
QuestInfo.1: After much cajoling from you and Butler, Gurnardson has agreed to let you into the city, but only if you can prove you can earn your keep there.
QuestInfo.2: To prove you can earn your keep in Svarti, you presented Gurnardson with Hellfang Meat. But he refused it, declaring he would never eat such tough, tasteless meat.

default.0: You were supposed to bring quality meat!
